mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM crm_email_suppression WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND email_hash = #{emailHash})
SELECT email_hash FROM crm_email_suppression WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND email_hash IN #{hash}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_email_suppression (tenant_id, email_hash, reason, source_recipient_id, unsubscribed_time, create_by, create_time) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{emailHash}, #{reason}, #{sourceRecipientId}, #{unsubscribedTime}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE suppression_id = suppression_id
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_lead SET unsubscribe_flag = 1, version = version + 1, update_by = 'email-unsubscribe', update_time = #{now} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND lead_id = #{targetId} AND deleted = 0 AND unsubscribe_flag = 0

UPDATE crm_customer SET unsubscribe_flag = 1, version = version + 1, update_by = 'email-unsubscribe', update_time = #{now} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND customer_id = #{targetId} AND deleted = 0 AND unsubscribe_flag = 0
